members.title: Second child dies after alleged Blue Mountain stabbing as mother faces additional murder charge
members.lead: One-year-old dies after alleged attack on Sunday, while three-year-old sibling remains in critical condition Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast A baby has died in a Sydney hospital five days after a mother allegedly stabbed them and two other children in the Blue Mountains, police say.
